name: Hasky Shelf
tagline: A shelf for the books you write and collect.
description: Books stand cover-out in a cabinet lit by a neon tube that takes the color of your Omarchy theme. Write your own book, add the PDFs and EPUBs you already have, and share a book as a single file.
features: Write a book: it saves by itself as you go
Add PDF and EPUB files by dragging them onto the window
Share a book you wrote as an EPUB any reader opens
Your books stay in a folder on your own machine
